contentText:
Gustavo Dudamel shows you how he created his segment in the World Cup Halftime show. From working with Chris Martin to BTS, keep watching to see how it all came to life!

Tetris Kelly:

Gustavo Dudamel brought huge energy and surprises to the first ever World Cup halftime show, and we have the experience directly from his eyes. We take you there in Billboard All Access. It was an epic show that included yes, BTS and Justin Bieber. Hallelujah! How cool to see V congratulate the pop king. But Gustavo had the whole world smiling with the Muppets. Yes, animals at the World Cup. 

Gustavo Dudamel:

You are doing amazing. 

He worked with icon, Chris Martin, on the epic ending. To stay with ll the access, keep it locked with Billboard News.

Everybody, take care.
